rules: Every TV gets its own unique ID and record. Never reuse one TV's ID for another.
Nothing for an off-site TV may be tied to a home network address.
Nothing runs on a TV without its owner present, saying go.

identity.kit_record: tvkit new --site OFFSITE mints a fresh UUID v4 tv_id (a record file). Never reused, never copied from another TV.
identity.pairing_code: If your request service uses pairing codes: read one out by phone while the owner is at the pairing screen. Never put it in a record, file or email.
identity.address: No address of any kind is part of the identity. The record stores no adb target.

tv_reaches: your requests page (the requests_url you set for this TV; the only address of yours the TV uses)
the TV's normal internet: Google Play, any streaming apps the owner uses
tv_never_uses: any private (RFC 1918) address, .local or .lan name of your home network
your home DNS server or ad-blocker (the TV keeps its own router's DNS)
a local media-server address (the media app finds its server through its own account)
your home dashboard or any web portal inside your network
Home Assistant or any other home-automation system

r-browser.what: TV Bro (pinned in kit.json) opens your requests page URL on the TV (tvkit open-requests, or the owner types it in).
r-browser.why_recommended: Already pinned and checked by the kit, nothing new to build or sideload.

own-app.what: A small app of your own that talks to the same page. Not part of this kit: tvkit does not install it.
own-app.when: Only if you build one; then pin it in kit.json like the others.

requests.note: A TV at another address reaches only your requests page URL.

usb.who: The owner on their TV, you on the phone. No computer at their address.
usb.prep: tvkit usb-pack --tv <tv-id> --out <stick folder> (checks sha256 + signer against kit.json first, then copies the APKs and writes SHA256SUMS, READ-ME-ON-THE-TV.txt and tv-kit-offsite.json).

laptop.who: You in person with a laptop on their Wi-Fi.
laptop.prep: The normal runbook (check, baseline, wifi-check, install, after) with --target <the TV's address or USB serial> on every command. The target is never stored. tvkit refuses any target inside your home_networks.

checks_without_adb: Press Home: the Free My TV home appears.
Google Play opens from the Free My TV shelf or apps drawer.
Settings -> Network & Internet shows your Wi-Fi as Connected.
Settings -> Apps -> See all apps -> Show system apps: Google TV Home, the Google TV setup app, Google Play Games and YouTube Music show Disabled; nothing else you use does.
Your usual apps (YouTube, Netflix, ...) still open and play.
